A <strand Grapple /> hooks up to 22 meters away, dealing <pve 38 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and staggering enemies on impact, and attaches to enemies or objects.

Cancelling a <strand Grapple /> within 1 second of activation refunds 50% Grenade Energy.

Grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle fully refunds a <strand Grapple /> Ability Charge and grants Grapple Returned for 4 seconds, allowing immediate reactivation if the Grapple ends while the buff is active. Grenade Kickstart does not activate when grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle.

<strand Grapple Melee /> is performed by pressing [Melee Attack] while grappling, or for up to ? seconds after, while at a sufficiently fast speed. It deals <pve 432 /> <pvp [61] /> impact damage and up to <pve 432 /> <pvp [61] /> radial damage in a 4? meter radius, applying <strand Unravel /> and pushing enemies back. Guardians directly hit by a <strand Grapple Melee /> have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds.

<strand Grapple Melee /> counts as both a Grenade and Melee Ability. Ashes to Assets grants 50% less Super Energy when a <strand Grapple Melee /> is used with a Grapple Tangle.

<strand Grapple />'s passive ability regeneration is disabled until you are no longer airborne. This also applies to Silkstrike.
